name: SenseNova Vision 7B MoT
description: Offline Modly adapter for the complete pinned SenseNova-Vision-7B-MoT inference surface: generation, editing, understanding, dense perception, segmentation, detection, OCR, point-cloud reconstruction, and camera pose.
author: DrHepa

nodes.name: SenseNova Open Image Generation
nodes.description: Generate one PNG from a text prompt with the official generate mode.

params_schema.label: Seed
params_schema.tooltip: Upstream noise seed. Use -1 to leave the current random state unchanged.

params_schema.label: Diffusion Steps
params_schema.tooltip: Overrides the official 50-step default for image or point-map decoding.

params_schema.label: Text Guidance
params_schema.tooltip: Official classifier-free text guidance scale.

params_schema.label: Image Guidance
params_schema.tooltip: Official classifier-free image guidance scale for this mode.

params_schema.label: Reasoning Mode
params_schema.tooltip: Use the official low-level think mode. Image nodes may emit optional raw reasoning text.

nodes.description: Return the unmodified upstream tagged understanding text; an optional JSON resource wraps the raw response without semantic parsing.
